verdict.rationale: Digits delivers webhook event delivery to a configured endpoint, so a user can build event-triggered actions externally, and it automates bookkeeping on its own (auto-booking, automated reconciliation, transaction flagging). Nothing in the evidence shows users defining their own rules, either in the product or through the API. Missing for 10: a user-configurable rules engine (conditions → actions), documentation of webhook event types and subscription setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
